title.ko: 뉘앙스: 긍정·부정 함축 · 유의어 구별 · slim vs skinny
title.en: connotation: positive and negative shades of meaning and near-synonyms

explain.ko: 단어의 사전적 의미(denotation)와 별도로 감정이나 평가를 담은 함축의미(connotation)가 있습니다. 같은 사람을 stubborn(부정)이라고도, persistent(긍정)라고도 부를 수 있고, frugal(긍정)과 stingy(부정), slim(긍정)과 skinny(부정)처럼 같은 사실을 다른 시각으로 표현합니다. 글쓰기에서는 의도에 맞는 어휘를 골라야 하고, 객관적인 글에서는 중립적인 어휘를 쓰는 것이 좋습니다.
explain.en: Besides its dictionary meaning (denotation), a word carries emotional or evaluative connotation. The same person may be stubborn (negative) or persistent (positive); frugal (positive) vs stingy (negative); slim (positive) vs skinny (negative) describe the same facts from different viewpoints. In writing, choose words that match your intention, and prefer neutral words in objective texts.

notes.ko: 유의어 사전을 쓸 때 반드시 예문과 함축을 확인하세요.
notes.en: When using a thesaurus, always check examples and connotation.

lines.t: English has many words with similar meanings but different feelings. Slim and skinny both mean thin, but slim is positive and skinny is somewhat negative. Such differences are called connotation.

trans.ko: 영어에는 뜻이 비슷해도 느낌이 다른 단어가 많습니다. slim과 skinny는 모두 마른 것을 뜻하지만 slim은 긍정적이고 skinny는 다소 부정적입니다. 이런 차이를 함축의미라고 합니다.

options: Slim is positive, skinny is negative

items.passage:
BLOG
The power of words
The same person can give a completely different impression depending on how they're described. A confident person may be called arrogant, and a careful person may be called timid. When choosing words, consider both intention and connotation.

prompt.en: Compare near-synonyms with different connotations in 4 sentences.

task.model: Calling someone frugal is praise, while calling them stingy is criticism. Stubborn sounds negative, whereas persistent sounds positive. The impression changes depending on how you describe the same person. So when choosing words, connotations must be considered carefully.

model_trans.ko: 검소하다는 말은 칭찬이지만 인색하다는 말은 비난입니다. 고집이 세다는 말은 부정적이지만 끈기 있다는 말은 긍정적입니다. 같은 사람을 어떻게 부르느냐에 따라 인상이 달라집니다. 그래서 단어를 고를 때는 함축의미를 신중히 고려해야 합니다.
model_trans.en: Calling someone frugal is praise, while calling them stingy is criticism. Stubborn sounds negative, whereas persistent sounds positive. The impression changes depending on how you describe the same person. So when choosing words, connotations must be considered carefully.
